name: Stonefish

items.name: Camouflage
items.text: The stonefish can hide in its natural environment even if it doesn't have cover.

items.name: Defensive Spines
items.text: When a creature moves into a space with one or more stonefish, that creature takes 1d4 piercing damage and is exposed to stonefish venom.

items.name: Stonefish Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 16 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 3 hours

Stage 1 Clumsy 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 Clumsy 2 (10 minutes)

Stage 3 3d6 poison and clumsy 2 (1 hour)

text: Stonefish use their superior camouflage to lie in wait and devour small prey, becoming indistinguishable from the reefs they call home. Larger creatures are also at risk, although mostly through accidental contact with the stonefish's spines and their agonizing venom.
